recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-5601 unless a future work-group decision asks to make the regex a formal invariant or revise the regex itself.
issue_request: FHIR-5601 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 fhir-i change request asking for Reference.reference to explicitly specify the identifier/address format, preferably with a regex, so implementations would not invent incompatible interpretations.
initial_application: The Jira resolution notes svn revision 4675 in references.html. Git history maps this to git-svn commit 1fd638cecf3c240c636198c06924d3725703eb98, whose message includes '#5601 - regex for proper resource reference on API' and whose patch adds the regex to source/references.html.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini maps the Reference datatype to the references page, confirming source/references.html is the active build-scope datatype narrative. Later Published issues FHIR-29271 and FHIR-31422 use the same references.html#regex anchor in Bundle resolution/fullUrl clarifications, but they do not supersede the FHIR-5601 distinction between RESTful API-shaped references and other valid references. Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because source/references.html already states the allowed literal-reference URL forms, provides the FHIR API consistency regex, and says both that matching the regex does not prove a FHIR server and not matching it does not make the reference non-compliant.

related_jiras.note: Published bundle reference-resolution clarification that uses the references.html#regex anchor without changing the original FHIR-5601 API-shaped-reference guidance.
Published Bundle.entry.fullUrl clarification that preserves non-RESTful URI cases while using the regex to identify RESTful-looking type/id URLs.
